correctness.rationale: For finite-dimensional positive-definite Gaussian pairs, whitening P and diagonalizing the relative precision gives log(p/q) as a constant plus the sum of (u_i−1)Z_i^2/2−u_i m_i Z_i under P. The normal quadratic and linear terms have zero cross covariance, yielding k_i=[h(u_i)+u_i m_i^2]/2 and v_i=(u_i−1)^2/2+u_i^2 m_i^2. At fixed k_i>0 the feasible u are exactly the two-root closed interval, with m_i^2=(2k_i−h(u))/u. The derivative of the resulting v with respect to u is 2k_i−h(u), strictly positive in the interior; endpoints have m_i=0. The endpoint functions have derivative 2u_±(k) and strict concavity/convexity on k>0. By continuity at zero and strict subadditivity of the lower endpoint function (superadditivity of the upper), equality at K>0 requires a single nonzero k_i. All other modes have u_i=1,m_i=0, so the means coincide. Varying the one nontrivial mode across its interval constructs every V in every dimension; K=0 forces P=Q. Direct bisection of h(u)=2K reproduced the displayed numerical V intervals at K=1 and 8. Inspected RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md, verify.py and requirements.txt; the frozen checker and its sampling assertions were not rerun. The entropy-production rescaling is conditional: Ding–Quan–Tu §3.3 eqs. (35)–(40) require exact score and infinite forward time, and use X sampled from P at the endpoint.

The supported distinction is the fixed-forward-KL attainable interval for forward log-likelihood-ratio variance, including equality and no gaps, not the general methodology or the physical identity.
residual_risks: General Gaussian information-spectrum or quadratic-form allocation work could supply a stronger criterion not identified in the inspected sources; the inconclusive public lookup is not evidence against such coverage.

value.rationale: A fixed mean log-likelihood ratio does not constrain the variance to one value even within full-rank Gaussians. The result gives sharp, dimension-free extremes, exact extremizers and realizability of all intermediate variances; these let researchers benchmark Gaussian fluctuation comparisons without arbitrary dimensional or conditioning cutoffs. The physical application is limited to the cited endpoint assumptions.
